query:
CREATE TABLE `sound_settings` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`sound_type` enum('bell','chime','alarm','beep','siren','notification','custom') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'chime',
	`sound_volume` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 70,
	`is_enabled` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
	`animation_type` enum('pulse','flash','bounce','shake','rainbow','glow') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pulse',
	`animation_speed` enum('slow','normal','fast') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal',
	`custom_sound_url` varchar(500),
	`created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `sound_settings_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
